India A vs UAE in Rising Stars Asia Cup 2026

In the Rising Stars Asia Cup 2026, the United Arab Emirates (UAE) won the toss and elected to bat first against India A. The match is being played with Tilak Varma leading the India A team. India A has made three changes to their playing eleven, with Prabhsimran Singh, Harsh Dubey, and Arshad Khan replacing Ayush Badoni, Vipraj Nigam, and Prince Yadav.
